assertions.name: exact_transfer_matches_dense_gram
assertions.unit: max rel diff per-λ ‖ρ_λ(W)‖_F² transfer(50dps) vs dense einsum (float64) over n∈[6, 9, 9, 12]
assertions.source: doubled-Bratteli transfer ≡ dense ρ(W)·ρ(W)^T of gram_norm_binding_probe; agreement at the float64 floor of the dense reference (the transfer carries 50 dps).

assertions.name: n12_wall_cleared_by_transfer
assertions.unit: transfer reached ⁴He n=12 (and beyond) without d_λ materialisation
assertions.source: Σ_λ d_λ²=(3A)! caps the dense probe at A≤3 (opt-in ⁴He); the transfer is edge-count bound, not d_λ bound.

assertions.name: transfer_matches_hutchinson_within_error
assertions.unit: max |transfer(exact 50dps) − Hutchinson(float64 stochastic)| / σ_hutch over n∈[9, 12, 15] (units of Hutchinson standard errors; 3 = 3σ)
assertions.source: INDEPENDENT stochastic estimator probes/gram_qtrace_hutchinson_probe on the SAME word/♯/y_λ. Convention parity confirmed at n=9,12 (fully stochastic, exact_dim=0) where the transfer is ALSO pinned to the exact dense value; this is the ONLY validation at n=15 (⁵He), where dense is infeasible. Not an exact match — agreement within propagated sampling error.

description: EXACT d_λ-free doubled-Bratteli transfer for the quadratic Markov/Frobenius Gram norm G(W)=tr_M(W·W^♯)=Σ y_λ‖ρ_λ(W)‖_F²; drop-in exact replacement for the float64 dense gram_norm_binding_probe, clearing the n=12 dense wall (this run: max_n_reached=15; n=15 optional via --with-5he). Exploratory, no fit.

parameters.precision: mpmath 50-dps (EXACT; no float64 on the transfer path)
parameters.sharp_involution: word reversal; fixes q and each letter c·σ_g + d·1 (⇒ ρ(W^♯)=ρ(W)^T)
parameters.method: doubled fine-Bratteli transfer over pairs of edges (state=(a_{i+1}, b_i)); diagonal α·D(δ)+β when a_i==b_i, off-diagonal α·√(D(δ)D(−δ)+1) when a_i≠b_i; ‖ρ_λ(W)‖_F²=Σ_{S,T}(Π F_i)²
parameters.hutchinson_estimator: probes/gram_qtrace_hutchinson_probe: tr(F·R)=E_z[(Fᵀz)·(Rz)], Rademacher z; float64 + stochastic. Same word, same ♯ (reversal), same y_λ as the transfer — only exact-vs-stochastic differs.
